data.title: Income tax assessment for 2024 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterwolgast has assessed Frauke Beispielrade's income tax for 2024, resulting in a credit (Guthaben) of €433.00 to be refunded to her bank account. Because the credit arises, no late-filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) was imposed despite the late submission.
data.explanation: This is your official 2024 income tax assessment. Since your withheld wage tax was higher than the tax actually owed, the Finanzamt will refund you €433.00 automatically — no action is needed for that. If you think the calculation (income, deductions, or tax amount) is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterwolgast. The app will show you the exact deadline based on when the letter is deemed delivered. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final after that deadline passes. Keep this notice for your records in case you need it for future tax matters.
data.tax_note: This is the official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the 2024 tax year; keep it together with your other tax records.

items.title: Receive your income tax refund (Steuererstattung)
items.action: No action needed; the Finanzamt will transfer the credit to your bank account automatically.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the assessment
items.action: If you disagree with the tax calculation, file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterwolgast in writing, electronically, or recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the tax assessment becomes final and binding.
